title: Root Workspace Brand child-container asset materialization through canonical asset provenance

phases.objective: Materialize an already-known active Brand Core context source through a personal/company Root Workspace and its canonical child Brand container while retaining workspace_type=brand as a child operational workspace binding, reusing existing Brand mutation authority and canonical workspace asset identity/provenance without a new migration, provider content fetch, topology self-heal, or second authority store.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated workspace owner/admin or delegated Brand editor/manager with existing canonical Brand mutation authority
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The selected personal/company Root Workspace derives tenant scope; exactly one child workspace_type=brand binding and one direct inheritance-bearing Root Workspace contains Brand container path are proven; exactly one active Brand Core source is normalized into a canonical external_ref workspace asset input, serialized idempotently by the existing Resource Repository, projected back through canonical read authority, and classified as a governed state change. Missing or ambiguous topology fails closed and content_sha256 remains null unless a real content fetch establishes it.
steps: Authenticate through canonical User JWT middleware on the existing Resource API route family.

Resolve workspace_id from workspace_registry under lock, derive tenant_id from that row, require an active tenant, require workspace_ownership_type personal or company, and reject workspace_type=brand as a Root Workspace.
Resolve Brand mutation authority through the existing canonical Brand asset authority helper; do not promote Dynamic Container Authority shadow data into a new hard grant store in this slice.

Resolve exactly one child operational workspace_registry row with workspace_type=brand and linked_brand_key equal to the canonical Brand; reject any personal/company root ownership classification on that child row.
Resolve exactly one active canonical Brand container with canonical_subject_type=brand_target_key and exactly one active contains relationship from a Workspace container.

Require that Workspace container to resolve to the selected Root Workspace, require contains to contribute to inheritance, and require exactly one direct container_closure path with shortest_depth=1 and path_count=1.
Fail closed on missing, ambiguous, cross-workspace, stale, or multi-path Brand container topology; never INSERT containers or container_relationships from materialization.
Resolve exactly one active/validated Brand Core source by stable asset/doc/file/Google identity inside the canonical Brand.
Normalize source identity to asset_key, doc_key, or Google file identity without provider content fetch.

Build canonical asset input with asset_type=external_ref plus provenance metadata for Root Workspace, child Brand workspace, Brand container, containment relationship, Brand Core source revision, nullable content_sha256, and secrets_included=false.
Persist through createResourceRepository().insertAsset so the existing tenant/type/ref atomic identity contract serializes retries and concurrent calls.
Reject a changed Brand Core revision for the same durable asset identity when canonical provenance compatibility fails instead of silently refreshing lineage.
Read persisted lineage under lock and verify Root Workspace → Brand child/container → Brand Core provenance before commit, then project through canonical Resource Repository read authority.
Keep content_sha256 null when provider content was not fetched instead of hashing metadata and calling it content.
Compose the canonical OpenAPI path through the precise-contract registry fragment before generated frontend/OpenAPI parity is enforced.
Generate operation-governance and frontend/OpenAPI evidence only from the final exact source tree.
assertions: workspace_ownership_type personal/company remains separate from operational workspace_type; workspace_type=brand remains a child operational binding rather than a Root Workspace.
Brand container registry allows Workspace parents and contains contributes to both ancestry and inheritance; generic container dimensions include connections, assets, roles/policies and brand_core.
Caller cannot choose tenant_id for this mutation; tenant authority is derived from the selected Root Workspace.
A Brand container owned by another Root Workspace fails closed before source lookup or asset persistence.
Multiple active Workspace parents, missing closure, or multiple closure paths fail closed before asset persistence.
Legacy Brand Core rows with only a Google document/file identity can still produce a deterministic canonical source_ref.
Missing, ambiguous, inactive, or unverifiable Brand Core sources fail closed before asset persistence.
Missing or ambiguous workspace_type=brand child binding fails closed.
Brand Core reference materialization persists as canonical workspace_assets asset_type=external_ref and never depends on an undeclared brand_core asset type.
Retry and concurrent materialization converge on one canonical persisted asset through the existing Resource Repository serialization contract.
Changed source revision for the same durable asset identity fails with workspace_asset_identity_provenance_conflict rather than overwriting provenance.
Materialization does not query information_schema and does not require a separate workspace_assets provenance migration, parent_workspace_id column, or second authority model.
Materialization does not self-heal missing containers or containment relationships during the consequential write; Brand lifecycle/projection must establish canonical topology separately.
Only the canonical Resource API route family exposes the materialization mutation; no parallel materialization router is introduced.
The canonical OpenAPI authority documents POST /me/workspaces/{workspace_id}/brands/{brand_key}/assets/materialize-brand-core with User JWT and consequential mutation semantics.
The precise OpenAPI registry binds that runtime route to the canonical modular Brand Core materialization path item rather than allowlisting the route gap.
Provider content is not fetched and content_sha256 is not fabricated from provenance metadata.

The generated operation rule is state_change only when canonical JWT, Root Workspace classification, Brand authority, Brand child/container topology, source identity, transaction/readback and registered test evidence all pass.
No Migration Apply, Production/Hostinger/provider mutation, deployment, credential/secret access, force push or external send occurs in CI.
